name: CommuteAssistTrainStationExit

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short train arrival scene. A person has just arrived at a station and asks Sigma which exit to use. Sigma answers in one sentence. Done.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Train station concourse, crowd noise, announcement over PA, commuter bustle

initial_prompt: Generate an ultra-short train arrival scene. The person has just got off a train at a large station. They're not sure which exit leads toward their destination. They ask Sigma. Sigma gives the exit name or direction. Person moves toward it.

variations.context: Just arrived at a train station — quick exit check

setting.mood: In motion, slightly unsure, crowd around
setting.relationship_dynamic: Solo traveller in a busy station
setting.background: Just got off the train. Station is busy. Not sure which exit leads the right way.
setting.conversation_style: One quick question amid the station noise. One directional answer.

scenario_template.topic: Person asks Sigma which exit to take from the station
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. Into phone or earpiece. E.g. 'Sigma, which exit for the high street?' or 'Sigma, north or south exit for the hotel?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma names the exit or direction. Person heads that way.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: exit name or direction. One sentence. Person: 'got it' or just turns.

user1.name: Felix
user1.role: Just arrived at a train station. Needs the right exit fast. Speaks briefly into phone while moving.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Navigation assistant. Gives exit name or direction in one sentence. Nothing more.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Station is busy — person speaks quickly and quietly.
Sigma gives exit name or compass direction. One sentence.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Exit name or direction only. No extra info.
